news.title: Iran rebuffs Trump's plan for new round of peace talks, state media reports
news.description: Iran's top negotiator says his government has "no trust" in its enemies, after Trump says the U.S. won't be blackmailed.

news.title: FBI Director Kash Patel vows to sue The Atlantic over article claiming he abuses alcohol
